pages.text: When a blast destroys terrain, the cloud can disappear for a few seconds while the area is loaded again, then it returns.$(br2)Close to the blast this does not happen.
pages.title: Cloud disappears

pages.text: The Tsar Bomba seen from about 1000 blocks away can freeze the game when there is not enough RAM.$(br2)This is planned to be fixed in a later version.
pages.title: Large bombs
